newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end mostly flat but fuel gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end mostly flat but fuel gains.

text.p: NWE oil products ended steady to firmer on Wednesday.
Gasoline was flat and Eurograde barges traded between $204 and $205.50 fob ARA.
Naphtha was unchanged. EGPC's latest six month tender from Suez and Alexandria closed.
Gas oil pared Tuesday's losses as June IPE gas oil futures recuperated from their $5.75 fall. Heating oil barges traded at June IPE +$1.25 and +$1.50 fob ARA and +$1.75 for fob Rotterdam.

High sulphur barges lifted to $80/$81 on better bunker demand. Cargo markets failed to respond to the Portuguese utility company tender, heard won by a Portuguese refiner and Italian trader. Low sulphur was offered at $96 a tonne fob.
